title: Watchlist page shows redundant "来源" and "来源Run" columns that duplicate category name information
description:
Expected: Category name alone provides sufficient source information. "来源" and "来源Run" columns should be removed from the table display. Source-task filter dropdown can also be removed since category filter serves the same purpose.
Actual: Two redundant columns displayed: "来源" (entry_source) and "来源Run" (entry_task_id). The "来源Run" column is machine-readable only (run IDs). The "来源" column duplicates info already in category names. Both waste horizontal space.
reproduce_command: Open watchlist page, select a category created by Selection Center. Observe "来源" and "来源Run" columns showing data already encoded in the category name (e.g. "选股中心-2026-05-25-qe_xxx 策略回测16").

events.note: Backend fields entry_source/entry_task_id retained for programmatic use (Selection Center, QE archive). Only frontend display columns removed.
Source-task filter dropdown also removed — category filter provides equivalent functionality.
Merged to main, pushed to GitHub. Post-merge L0 passed. Removed 82 lines: 2 table columns, source-task filter, search field, state, filter function, useEffect deps.
